name: Cole Ranch

land: Slopes face several ways, so growers can pick warmer or cooler spots to suit each grape.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A tiny Mendocino County AVA in a narrow mountain valley between Boonville and Highway 101, at about ⟦elev|1,400 feet|430 m⟧.
